name: Mynth
description_short: Cross-chain swap network for any token pair.
description_long: Cross-chain swap network bridging Cardano with any-token-to-any-token routes across multiple chains, alongside the MyUSD stablecoin and an order-book DEX SDK. The Cardano products have since been discontinued — the smart contracts, SDK and stablecoin repositories are archived, and the company has pivoted to an agentic-AI platform for automating software development, unrelated to Cardano.
